explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/533: for δ > 0 and large n, must a K₅-free graph with ≥ δn² edges contain ≫_δ n vertices spanning no triangle? Disproved by Balogh–Lenz. The statement negates: for every δ > 0 there is c > 0 such that, eventually, every K₅-free G with ≥ δn² edges has a set S of size ≥ cn with CliqueFreeOn S 3. Faithful.
